blocks.text: Check our Miss Universe 2026 live updates page to get the latest news and features The “most beautiful day in the universe” culminated with the coronation of a new queen, Jennifer Barreto from Puerto Rico who enjoyed a homecourt advantage with the 75th edition of the Miss Universe pageant being held in her country. Barreto bested 115 other aspirants from around the world at the competition held at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico Jose Miguel Agrelot in San Juan, Puerto Rico on Nov. 24 (25 in Manila).
